name: Adeait Product Writer for WooCommerce
author: hunt3xxx

sections.description:
Adeait Product Writer for WooCommerce adds a powerful AI writing assistant directly inside every WooCommerce product editor. Powered by Claude AI from Anthropic, it generates ready-to-publish product content in seconds.

What it does

  • One-click generation — Title, short description, full description and SEO meta, all at once
  • Bulk writer — Process up to 50 products in one go
  • 8 languages — Norwegian, English, Swedish, Danish, German, French, Spanish, Dutch
  • 5 writing tones — Professional, Friendly, Luxury, Technical, Minimalist
  • SEO ready — Auto-fills Yoast SEO and RankMath fields
  • Preview before applying — Review generated content before it touches your product
  • Cost control — Set a monthly generation limit to keep API costs predictable (~$0.003 per product)

How it works

  1. Install the plugin and enter your Anthropic API key (free at console.anthropic.com)
  2. Open any WooCommerce product
  3. Add optional keywords or notes in the AI panel
  4. Click Generate Everything
  5. Review the preview and click Apply to Product

Privacy

Product name, category and any keywords you enter are sent to Anthropic’s API to generate content. No data is stored by this plugin beyond your settings. See Anthropic’s privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to WooCommerce → Adeait Product Writer and enter your Anthropic API key
  4. Open any product and use the Adeait Product Writer panel
sections.faq:
Where do I get an API key?

At console.anthropic.com. New accounts get free credits to start with.

How much does it cost to use?

Approximately $0.003 per full product generation (title + descriptions + SEO meta). Generating only a title or short description costs less.

Does it work with Yoast SEO and RankMath?

Yes. If either plugin is active, the AI automatically fills in the SEO title and meta description fields.

Can I generate descriptions for many products at once?

Yes. Go to WooCommerce → Adeait Bulk Writer to select and process up to 50 products in one batch.

What languages are supported?

Norwegian, English, Swedish, Danish, German, French, Spanish and Dutch. More languages can be suggested via support.

Is my data safe?

Only product name, category and your optional keywords are sent to Anthropic. No customer data, pricing or orders are ever shared.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Replaced Gumroad URLs in plugin header with company website URLs for WordPress.org compliance
  • Synced plugin version metadata with the review upload

1.2.0

  • Renamed plugin to Adeait Product Writer for WooCommerce (unique brand prefix)
  • Updated all code prefixes from waw_ to adpw_ (4+ character prefix per WordPress.org guidelines)
  • Updated text domain to adeait-product-writer-for-woocommerce
  • Added Requires Plugins: woocommerce header
  • Added allowlist validation for model, tone, and language settings
  • Fixed XSS: status messages now use safe text rendering instead of HTML
  • Removed nonce refresh endpoint in favor of standard page reload on session expiry
  • Reduced readme tags to 5 (WordPress.org limit)
  • Removed promotional comparison claims from readme description

1.1.2

  • Security: Full internationalization — all 50+ user-facing strings now use proper i18n functions
  • Security: API key can now be defined as constant in wp-config.php for extra safety
  • Security: Fixed potential XSS in bulk writer error messages
  • Security: Raw AI response no longer included in AJAX payload
  • Security: Added wp_unslash() on all $_POST inputs before sanitization
  • Improved: All single-line conditionals now use braces (WordPress coding standards)

1.1.1

  • Security: Improved output escaping throughout the admin interface
  • Security: Added capability checks on all AJAX endpoints
  • Security: AI-generated content is now sanitized with wp_kses_post before saving

1.1.0

  • Fixed: Generate buttons now correctly prevent form submission
  • Improved: Script version uses file modification time to prevent browser caching issues

1.0.1

  • Updated to latest Anthropic model
  • Updated WooCommerce compatibility to 9.5
  • Requires PHP 8.0+

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • One-click AI generation for title, descriptions and SEO meta
  • Bulk writer for up to 50 products
  • 8 languages, 5 tones
  • Yoast SEO and RankMath integration
